serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Wait a minute, that’s something new. “Newly elected pope named himself Goku the second and here is why it will help people of color". I didn’t hear anything about the old one dying. Isn’t retiring, like, cheating?
Oh man, religion huh? When I was younger I went to church with my parents. It wasn’t anything special for me at the time. 
Isn’t changing a pope a big deal? Maybe something will change because of it. \nWell, it wouldn’t be bad to go to church some day and check it out. \n
